expected_performance.notes: Reaching 0.94+ requires training components (ProtoSSM sequence modeling) which are excluded from this inference-only task. The reference notebooks achieve 0.925-0.946 primarily through ProtoSSM training (+0.005-0.010), isotonic calibration (+0.001), and per-class thresholding. Inference-only integration can optimize the existing two-branch ensemble but cannot close the full gap to 0.94+ without retraining.
